description:
When a VHD(x) volume is detached unexpectedly, the FSLogix system will attempt to reattach the volume. This value specifies the number of seconds to wait between retries. The default value is 10 seconds which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\ReAttachIntervalSeconds
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 1, Max = 60
